    AI Overview
    In the 2026 Final Four matchup, the UConn Huskies defeated the Illinois Fighting Illini 71-62 on April 4, 2026, to advance to the national championship, driven by Tarris Reed Jr.'s 17 points and 11 rebounds
    . Keaton Wagler led Illinois with 20 points, despite shooting 2-for-10 from three. UConn held Illinois to 35% shooting and capitalized on 12-of-33 3-point shooting. 
    UConn Huskies Key Player Stats (Apr 4, 2026) 
    • Tarris Reed Jr.: 17 points, 11 rebounds
    • Braylon Mullins: Added key 3-point shooting in the second half
    • Team: 35% Field Goals, 36% 3-Point FG, 88% Free Throws 
    Illinois Fighting Illini Key Player Stats (Apr 4, 2026) 
    • Keaton Wagler: 20 points, 8 rebounds, 7-for-16 shooting
    • Tomislav Ivisic: Contributed to a late second-half surge
    • Team: 34% Field Goals, 23% 3-Point FG, 78% Free Throws 
    Game Summary
    UConn led by as many as 14 and went nearly 30 minutes without a turnover. Illinois, led by freshman standout Keaton Wagler and their Eastern European contingent, cut the lead to 57-53 with 5 minutes left after a 10-0 run, but could not complete the comeback.
